name: Mild steel mail suit
description: Mild steel rings riveted into one suit from the crown of the head to the ankles, coif, sleeves and legs all of a piece. It wants padding underneath and is very heavy.
notes: The model's root: mail in `steel-mail`. Folded to 380 mm by 460 mm and 60 mm tall: a long mail shirt with sleeves along its sides, the legs folded up over the body under a leather belt with a brass buckle, and the attached coif standing at the neck, 160 mm tall in all, its face opening forward and edged in leather. CHECK VOLUME LENGTH: the reference gives the mail packed tight in a 140 to 150 mm bundle; folded flat on a shelf it is far longer and its box far emptier, and the mass is the reference's. Slot `vest`, the body armour slot; no slot spans the whole body, so it should also block the head, arms and legs slots once a slot can cover more than one region. The reference gives no warmth. Protection is a judgement for riveted mail by grade: strong against cuts, fair against points, weak against blows. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
